properties.description: **Professional** — Active security posture for Maps: controls that produce signals an operations team must act on. This tier delivers network hardening (public access disabled, VNet integration, firewall rules). Together these policies protect against unauthorized network exposure, exploitable vulnerabilities, and undetected privilege misuse. Maps to NIS2 Article 21 (detection & response), ISO 27001 A.12.4 (logging) and A.13 (network security).

metadata.policyName: Configure Azure Maps Accounts to disable public network access
CORS should not allow every resource to access your map account.
